mentions.name: Scorchball TV
mentions.description: A 24/7 live sports channel simulated in pixel art, built as a hobby project with Claude Code. It runs as a static site with no server: every viewer's browser simulates the same league from a published daily seed, so everyone watching sees the same broadcast at the same time.
mentions.source_excerpt: I used Claude Code to create a little hobby project: a 24/7 live sports channel, simulated in pixel art, called Scorchball TV.
mentions.author: scorchball
